driver-layers.title: Three layers, one of them yours
driver-layers.alt: Layer diagram: the application calls the hardware-agnostic driver, which calls the communication interface, which the platform port implements with the MCU's SDK, which talks to the chip.
driver-layers.description: From top to bottom. The application calls the driver object. The driver turns each call into register or command transactions and never touches the hardware itself. The communication interface is the small set of methods the driver calls (transfer, GPIO, delay). The platform port implements them with the MCU's SDK. Below it is the chip. A repository replaces this hand-placed figure with one whose data() reads the real class and method names from its headers.
